_note: Burger Chain upgrades. Same format as v0.1 upgrades.json. Weak spots are slow travel and high costs, so Franchises and Bulk Buying fix them. kitchen skips bb_inspection, veggie skips bb_meat.

trees.name: Product
trees.blurb: Make the food better so more people come back.

trees.name: Channels
trees.blurb: Open more places and get more people through the door.

trees.name: Defense
trees.blurb: Keep your regulars and your money.

upgrades.name: Secret Sauce
upgrades.desc: A sauce nobody can stop eating. Every fan tells more friends.

upgrades.name: Crispy Fries
upgrades.desc: The best fries in town. People post them online.

upgrades.name: Veggie Burger
upgrades.desc: A tasty burger with no meat. More people say yes, and meat prices hurt you less.

upgrades.name: Combo Meals
upgrades.desc: Burger, fries and a drink for one price. Each visit earns more and you get more Hype bubbles.

upgrades.name: Local Menus
upgrades.desc: A spicy burger in Mexico, a teriyaki burger in Japan. Hard markets open up.

upgrades.name: Food Photos
upgrades.desc: Post photos of juicy burgers. Works best where people are online a lot.

upgrades.name: Delivery App
upgrades.desc: Burgers delivered to your door. Works best where there are many shops.

upgrades.name: Bolt the Mascot
upgrades.desc: A fun mascot that kids love. More fans and more Hype bubbles.

upgrades.name: Franchises
upgrades.desc: Other people open restaurants with your name. Your brand jumps to new regions much faster.

upgrades.name: TV Ads
upgrades.desc: Ads during the big match. Growth goes up everywhere, but it costs a lot every day.

upgrades.name: Spotless Kitchens
upgrades.desc: Clean kitchens, happy guests. Health inspections never hurt you.

upgrades.name: Bulk Buying
upgrades.desc: Buy buns by the truckload. Daily costs go down a lot.

upgrades.name: Secret Recipe
upgrades.desc: Nobody knows what is in the sauce. The rival copies you more slowly.

upgrades.name: Regulars Club
upgrades.desc: The 10th burger is free. Regulars collect Hype bubbles for you and stay loyal.

upgrades.name: Lawyers
upgrades.desc: Sue the copycat. Their copy loses 20% right now and goes slower after.
